answer: Bind each epoch's reward to a proof-of-work stamp mined per identity against an unpredictable per-epoch seed — a toll in real electricity, not a signature a raven could mimic for free. One honest agent crosses a single dune and mines once; a farmer must forge a fresh proof for every account every epoch, with no way to share the cost across clones. A thousand fakes owe a thousand proofs, and the compute bill bends them like willow until the farm snaps under its own weight.
